findings.current: Jamukha watched the terrible strike, a fusion of defeat and swiftness, cut through the air.
findings.defect: “A fusion of defeat and swiftness” makes defeat sound like a property of the strike, obscuring the action at its climax.
findings.rationale: The surrounding passage presents the strike as swift and overpowering; the replacement makes that description readable without changing the action.
findings.replacement: Jamukha watched the terrible strike, overwhelming in its power and speed, cut through the air.
